description: This Java class defines a mapping between Hive table types and client table types, including methods for type conversion and retrieval of supported table type names.

classes.name: ClassicTableTypeMapping
classes.description: A class that maps Hive table types to client types and vice versa, supporting type conversion and retrieval of supported types.

methods.name: mapToHiveType
methods.description: Converts a client table type name to corresponding Hive table types.

methods.name: mapToClientType
methods.description: Converts a Hive table type name to the corresponding client table type.

methods.name: getTableTypeNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all supported table type names.

search-terms: Hive to client table type mapping
